articles.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals will pay AbCellera $56M upfront for two initial antibody-discovery programs (plus $28M for a third), with up to $792M in milestones per program, to develop multispecific T-cell engagers for GI and other solid tumors.
articles.notes: Competitor partnership; benchmark for antibody discovery deal economics

articles.title: Memento Medicines Launches with $93 Million Series A Financing to Advance Tie2 Agonist and VEGF Inhibitor Bispecific Antibody Therapy for Retinal Diseases
articles.summary: New biotech Memento Medicines launched with a $93M Series A to advance a bispecific antibody co-targeting Tie2 and VEGF for retinal disease, signaling continued investor appetite for bispecific antibody platforms.

articles.title: LabGenius Therapeutics and LG Chem Enter a Research Collaboration, Option and License Agreement to Develop an AI/ML-Designed Tumour-Targeting Antibody
articles.summary: LabGenius will use its EVA AI/ML antibody discovery platform under a new multi-year collaboration and license deal with LG Chem to design next-generation multispecific tumor-targeting antibodies.
articles.notes: Validates AI/ML antibody discovery platform licensing model

articles.title: Voro Therapeutics and Alloy Therapeutics Enter Strategic Research Collaboration to Advance Next-Generation Masked T-Cell Engager Therapeutics
articles.summary: Voro Therapeutics and Alloy Therapeutics announced a collaboration combining Voro's tumor-activated biologics with Alloy's antibody discovery and T-cell engager engineering capabilities.

articles.title: Servo-Actuated 3D-Printed Disposable Microvalves for Automated, Scalable Organoid Culture in Standard Incubators
articles.summary: A bioRxiv preprint describes low-cost, 3D-printed disposable microvalves that automate organoid culture media exchange in standard incubators without specialized microfluidic equipment.
articles.notes: Tangential — lab automation hardware, not antibody-specific

articles.title: Harbour BioMed and BioMap Jointly Initiate MegaStream TechBio, A Leading Global Drug Development Platform, Joins Forces with Premier Life Science Foundation Models to Set New Benchmarks for AI-Driven Complex Biologics R&D
articles.summary: Harbour BioMed and BioMap launched MegaStream TechBio, a joint venture combining global biologics drug development with foundation-model AI to accelerate complex biologics R&D.
articles.notes: Major AI-biologics platform JV; relevant benchmark for AI/ML antibody development partnership models

articles.title: Axcelead DDP Joins Lilly TuneLab to Advance AI Drug Discovery
articles.summary: Japanese CRO Axcelead Drug Discovery Partners joined Eli Lilly's TuneLab program, gaining access to Lilly's AI models for early-stage drug discovery.
articles.notes: Expands Lilly's external AI drug discovery network; signals growing AI tool access for biotech partners

articles.title: VERAXA Biotech Establishes In Vitro Proof-of-Concept for Novel BiTAC-ADC Technology Platform and Launches Partnering Discussions at BIO International Convention 2026
articles.summary: VERAXA Biotech demonstrated in vitro proof-of-concept for its novel bispecific tumor-activated conjugate (BiTAC)-ADC platform and is now seeking partners.
articles.notes: Novel ADC conjugation/targeting platform; relevant to antibody-drug conjugate engineering trends

articles.title: 10x Genomics and Cleveland Clinic Collaborate to Advance Research in Diagnostic Applications of Single-Cell and Spatial Technologies in Patients with Bladder Cancer
articles.summary: 10x Genomics and Cleveland Clinic partnered to apply single-cell and spatial technologies toward diagnostic biomarker discovery in bladder cancer.
articles.notes: Tangential — diagnostic biomarker discovery, not core to antibody/protein reagent dev, but tracks relevant platform-tech advances

articles.title: Receptor-guided AAV Tropism Engineering via MATCH
articles.summary: A new computational MATCH framework uses receptor-binding data to guide AAV capsid engineering toward improved tissue-specific tropism.
articles.notes: Background — receptor-informed capsid engineering approach relevant to tissue-targeted AAV design

articles.title: Improved Protein Encapsulation and Delivery by Lipid Nanoparticles with Refined Ionizable Lipid Content
articles.summary: Refining ionizable lipid content in LNP formulations improves protein cargo encapsulation efficiency and delivery performance.
articles.notes: Background — relevant to protein/reagent payload LNP formulation work

articles.title: Agent-Guided De Novo Design of Nanobody Binders Against a Novel Cancer Target
articles.summary: An agentic four-stage workflow combining epitope identification, generative design, and yeast display screening produced sub-nanomolar nanobody binders against a novel cancer target.
articles.notes: Background — agentic AI-guided nanobody discovery pipeline

articles.title: A highly potent nanobody-based bispecific therapeutic provides broad-spectrum protection against ebolavirus
articles.summary: Camelid nanobodies were fused into a bispecific construct that neutralizes EBOV, SUDV, and BDBV and protects rodents against all three viruses.
articles.notes: Background — bispecific nanobody-Fc fusion engineering transferable beyond infectious disease

articles.title: Resolving antibody avidity through nanoscale antigen patterning
articles.summary: SPR, TEM, and cryo-EM combined with a five-state biophysical model distinguish monovalent from bivalent antibody binding states using nanoscale antigen patterning.
articles.notes: Background — biophysical characterization method relevant to avidity/affinity profiling

articles.title: A paired sequence language model for protein-protein interaction modeling
articles.summary: PPLM jointly encodes paired protein sequences to enable interaction-aware representations, with its affinity variant outperforming ESM2 and structure-based methods on binding affinity prediction.
articles.notes: Background — sequence-based affinity prediction model relevant to antibody-antigen binding

articles.title: Origin-1: a generative AI platform for de novo antibody design against novel epitopes
articles.summary: In under 100 design attempts per target, Origin-1 identified developable, specific antibodies validated by biophysical assays against four novel targets.
articles.notes: Background — generative antibody design platform with high hit rate

articles.title: Machine learning enables efficient and effective affinity maturation of nanobodies
articles.summary: ML-guided affinity maturation of RXFP1-targeting nanobodies produced multiple sub-nanomolar binders, including a ~2500-fold improvement over wild-type.

articles.title: Portal Biotechnologies Accelerates Growth with Latest Round Led by NFX, Expanded DARPA Contract, and Broad Adoption Across Top Pharma and Academic Centers
articles.summary: Portal Biotechnologies closed an oversubscribed $9M round led by NFX for its mechanoporation-based cell engineering platform, now used for high-throughput screening at 100+ sites including top-10 pharma.
articles.notes: Fresh (June 18) — mechanoporation delivery platform with strong pharma adoption; relevant to high-throughput discovery workflows

articles.title: Telos Biotech Announces Strategic Evaluation Collaboration with Made Scientific to Assess TELOVANCE Across Multiple Cell Therapy Manufacturing Platforms
articles.summary: Telos Biotech and CDMO Made Scientific will evaluate TELOVANCE, an ancillary technology addressing telomere shortening, across CAR-T, NK-cell, and HSPC manufacturing workflows.
articles.notes: Tangential — cell therapy manufacturing CMC, not core antibody/protein reagent focus

articles.title: Syncell Launches Global Discovery CRO Service to Unlock Drug Targets With Nanoscopic Proteomics
articles.summary: Syncell transitioned from platform developer to CRO, offering end-to-end subcellular spatial proteomic profiling combining its Microscoop Mint platform with a high-end mass spectrometer.
articles.notes: Background — new CRO service offering spatial proteomics for target discovery

articles.title: Fapon Biopharma and MOTE Therapeutics to Present Dual-Platform B-Cell Immunotherapy Franchise at BIO 2026
articles.summary: Fapon Biopharma and MOTE Therapeutics will present a combined B-cell immunotherapy platform franchise at the BIO International Convention 2026.
articles.notes: Tangential — conference presentation, limited new technical detail disclosed

articles.title: Beyond accuracy, precision and TAE: Direct assay validation against product specification aligned with USP <1033>
articles.summary: Proposes validating bioassays directly against product specification limits rather than only accuracy/precision metrics, aligning with the draft USP <1033> Total Analytical Error framework.
articles.notes: Background — statistical framework relevant to potency assay validation strategy ahead of USP <1033> finalization

articles.title: Towards automated gating of clinical flow cytometry data
articles.summary: FLAG-X, a Python package, automates flow cytometry gating with machine learning while integrating with standard manual-gating software pipelines.
articles.notes: Background — ML-based flow cytometry gating automation tool

articles.title: An Automated End-to-End Workflow for Production of Secreted Proteins in Transfected Mammalian Cells
articles.summary: Describes a fully automated, end-to-end pipeline for transient transfection and secreted protein production in mammalian cells, reducing manual handling for reagent-scale expression.
articles.notes: Background — automation workflow directly applicable to protein reagent production pipelines

articles.title: Oncology Pharmaceuticals: Streamlined Nonclinical Safety Studies for Biologics and Conjugated Products; Draft Guidance for Industry
articles.summary: FDA draft guidance proposes streamlined nonclinical safety/toxicology study approaches for oncology biologics and conjugated products such as ADCs; comments due July 31, 2026.
articles.notes: Directly applicable — reduced nonclinical testing burden relevant to ADC/biologics IND-enabling strategy

articles.title: General Considerations for the Use of New Approach Methodologies in Drug Development; Draft Guidance for Industry
articles.summary: FDA draft guidance outlines principles for qualifying and using non-animal new approach methodologies, including in vitro/cell-based assays, in drug development.
articles.notes: Background — relevant to cell-based bioassay/NAM qualification strategy

articles.title: CTCF regulates wild-type and recombinant AAV gene expression by shaping viral chromatin
articles.summary: Chromatin-remodeling factor CTCF shapes rAAV transgene expression, boosting transduction up to 4-fold independent of capsid serotype.
articles.notes: Background — capsid-independent AAV expression enhancement mechanism relevant to vector engineering.

articles.title: Reversible CD28 checkpoint modulation by cyclic peptides outperforms biologic blockade under exposure-limited conditions
articles.summary: Cyclic peptide CD28 antagonists show superior reversible checkpoint modulation versus biologic blockade in bioassay-based potency comparisons under exposure-limited dosing.
articles.notes: Background — bioassay comparison methodology relevant to potency benchmarking; peptide- rather than antibody-focused.

articles.title: A liquid handling platform for standardised quantification of cell-free enzymatic activity encoded by antimicrobial resistance genes
articles.summary: Automated liquid-handling platform standardizes cell-free enzymatic activity quantification, demonstrating a reagent-screening workflow transferable to protein/antibody assay automation.
articles.notes: Background — generalizable automation/liquid-handling methodology; application domain (AMR genes) is tangential.

articles.title: Single-molecule validation and optimised protocols for the use of secondary nanobodies in multiplexed immunoassays
articles.summary: Study validates and optimizes secondary nanobody reagent protocols at single-molecule resolution for use in multiplexed immunoassay platforms.
articles.notes: Background — nanobody reagent tooling for multiplexed immunoassays; journal-published version of a 2025 bioRxiv preprint, not novel/recent.

articles.title: Designing AAV Capsid Protein with viability-guided Diffusion Model
articles.summary: Viability-guided diffusion model generates novel AAV capsid protein sequences optimized for functional viability, illustrating generative AI applied to capsid/protein engineering.
articles.notes: Background — generative diffusion modeling for capsid protein design.

articles.title: Triveni Bio Raises $65 Million Series C Financing to Expand Scope of First-in-Class Bispecific TRIV-573 Clinical Studies and Drive Next-Stage Company Growth
articles.summary: Triveni Bio raised $65M in Series C funding to expand clinical studies of its first-in-class bispecific antibody TRIV-573 and support company growth.
articles.notes: Competitive intel — bispecific antibody-focused biotech funding round.

articles.title: Antengene Announces Exclusive License Agreement with MPM BioImpact-Established K2 Therapeutics for ATG-106 and Option for Undisclosed Bispecific TCE
articles.summary: Antengene licensed ATG-106 to MPM BioImpact-backed K2 Therapeutics and granted an option on an undisclosed bispecific T-cell engager, signaling continued bispecific antibody dealmaking.
articles.notes: Fresh (1 day old) — bispecific TCE licensing deal directly relevant to competitive bispecific antibody landscape.

articles.title: Insilico Medicine to showcase AI-driven drug breakthroughs at BIO 2026 International Convention
articles.summary: Insilico Medicine will present its AI-driven drug discovery pipeline and breakthroughs at the BIO 2026 International Convention.
articles.notes: Background — general AI drug-discovery conference showcase.

articles.title: Quantifying endosomal escape in vivo to guide lipid nanoparticle design
articles.summary: A lysosomal barcoding strategy quantifies endosomal escape of LNP-delivered nucleic acids in vivo and identifies branched ionizable lipid designs that improve potent liver delivery.

articles.title: Receptor-guided AAV Tropism Engineering via MATCH
articles.summary: MATCH is a computational, receptor-guided framework for engineering AAV capsid tropism toward specific cell-surface receptors.

articles.title: Computational Rational Design of Larger AAV Icosahedral Capsids
articles.summary: Molecular simulations show a rationally enlarged 45 nm T=3 AAV capsid can stably package up to ~35 kb of cargo, well beyond wild-type capacity.

articles.title: Combination of engineered cell type-specific promoters and a high-efficiency AAV capsid restores hearing in adult DFNB1 mice model with demonstrated safety in nonhuman primate
articles.summary: Pairing a high-efficiency engineered AAV capsid with cell-type-specific promoters restores hearing in a DFNB1 mouse model and shows a favorable safety profile in nonhuman primates.

articles.title: Characterization of expression elements for an AAV delivered antibody in nonhuman primates when co-delivered with PD-L1
articles.summary: Study characterizes promoter and expression-element choices for AAV-delivered antibody constructs co-administered with PD-L1 in nonhuman primates, informing anti-drug-antibody risk and in vivo expression durability.

articles.title: Designing AAV Capsid Protein with viability-guided Diffusion Model
articles.summary: A viability-guided diffusion model generates novel AAV capsid protein sequences optimized for predicted folding and viability, illustrating generative design applied to vector engineering.

articles.title: ARID-sf: A physics-informed Deep Learning scoring function to improve Antibody-Antigen docking model ranking
articles.summary: ARID-sf is a physics-informed deep learning scoring function trained on 1.5M+ docking models that rapidly re-ranks antibody-antigen docking poses for higher accuracy.

articles.title: Resolving antibody avidity through nanoscale antigen patterning
articles.summary: PANMAP uses nanoscale antigen patterning to resolve and quantify antibody avidity, offering a new characterization tool for engineering multivalent antibody reagents.

articles.title: Impact of the N-glycosylation on full-length IgG2 and IgG4 antibodies: a comparative study using molecular dynamics simulations
articles.summary: Molecular dynamics simulations reveal how N-glycosylation differentially affects structure and stability across full-length IgG2 and IgG4 subclasses, informing glyco-engineering strategy.

articles.title: Better antibodies engineered with a GLIMPSE of human data
articles.summary: Infinimmune researchers describe GLIMPSE, a human-immune-repertoire-data-driven approach for engineering antibodies with improved developability and binding properties.

articles.title: Merck adds to biopharma's AI agenda with up to $510M+ Protillion pact
articles.summary: Merck signed an up-to-$510M deal with Protillion Biosciences to use its megascale data-generation platform (Prot-MaP) for AI-driven protein/biologics design and manufacturability screening.

articles.title: Lundbeck Partners with Cradle to Discover and Optimize Brain Disorder Treatments
articles.summary: Lundbeck partnered with AI protein-engineering platform Cradle on an end-to-end, feedback-driven workflow to advance two antibody programs targeting CNS diseases.

articles.title: Carterra Launches Industry's First 48-channel HT-SPR Platform for Advanced Label-free Biomolecular Screening and Characterization
articles.summary: Carterra launched Vega, a 48-channel high-throughput SPR platform delivering 12x the throughput of competing systems for biomolecular interaction screening and characterization.

articles.title: Advancements in the application of reporter gene cell lines in bioactivity evaluation of biological products
articles.summary: Review surveys recent advances in reporter gene cell-line bioassays for evaluating bioactivity/potency of biologic drug products in QC lot release.
